summary.name: Namelix
summary.one_liner: Namelix is an AI business name generator that creates short, brandable business names and checks domain availability, made by Brandmark.io.
use_cases: Coming up with a name for a new startup
Finding a short brandable name with an available domain
Generating name ideas tied to a business idea
Creating a logo for a newly named business
Brainstorming name options beyond dictionary-word combinations
summary.what_it_does: Namelix uses generative AI, via a custom LLM, to produce short, brandable business names relevant to a user's business idea. Users can filter results by name length, a specific keyword, or domain extension. Saving names trains the algorithm to give better recommendations over time. The site also offers domain search, with Namelix Domains described as offering free domain registration, and links to Brandmark.io for logo creation.
notable: Custom LLM aimed at more original names than general chatbots
Learns from saved names to improve recommendations
Generates logos via sister product Brandmark.io
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the listing tags it as free but the page itself does not confirm this
Domain free-registration claim is marketing text and its terms are not detailed on the page
